battle.name: 范陽起兵
battle.brief: 天寶十四載十一月初九，安祿山以平盧、范陽、河東三鎮節度使身份，集蕃部兵約十五萬、號稱二十萬，於薊城南郊誓師，以奉密詔討楊國忠、清君側為名舉兵，河北州縣望風而降。卡面科林斯青銅盔屬公元前六五〇年希臘重裝步兵裝備，距本役一千四百年，不在現場。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 755年歲末在幽州起兵的叛軍，主體是安祿山一人兼任的平盧、范陽、河東三鎮節度使軍。范陽治幽州，統漁陽、薊、營州、柳城諸州縣；平盧軍鎮在柳城至營州一帶，控扼契丹與室韋；河東軍鎮節度使治太原，屏障河東。三鎮自開元、天寶間屢經兼併之後地域相連、兵員互通，帳面合計兵十八萬三千九百人，另有同羅、契丹、奚、室韋、突厥等蕃部部眾可以徵發，合計實集約十五萬人，對外號稱二十萬。與之對抗的是唐廷中央直轄的官軍與河北道的地方軍：玄宗得報之後以皇六子榮王李琬為元帥、右金吾大將軍高仙芝為副元帥，率彍騎、飛騎及朔方兵東征；安西節度使封常清兼范陽、平盧節度使赴東都，募兵六萬守河陽橋；東京留守李憕與御史中丞盧奕分守洛陽；關中方面由哥舒翰領兵屯潼關，隴右、河西、劍南勤王軍與朔方節度使郭子儀、河東節度使李光弼所部分路北上；往後平叛更倚仗沙陀回紇、葛邏祿等外族助軍。河北道各州刺史、縣令在叛軍過境時多數逃散或開城迎降，朝廷在河北的行政與徵發體系幾乎一夜之間崩解。
countriesEn: The rebel force that rose in Youzhou at the end of 755 was built around the three regional armies whose jiedushi commands An Lushan held simultaneously: Pinglu, Fanyang and Hedong. Fanyang was administered from Youzhou and governed Yuyang, Ji, Yingzhou and Liucheng; the Pinglu command lay between Liucheng and Yingzhou and controlled access to the Khitan and Shewei; the Hedong command had its seat at Taiyuan and shielded Hedong. After the repeated mergers of the Xuanhe and Tianbao reigns, these three commands bordered one another and pooled their troops, their paper strength officially standing at 183,900 men, while the Tongluo, Khitan, Xi, Shewei and Turkic tribes of the north could be tapped for a further contingent: about 150,000 in all, announced to the outside world as 200,000. Against them stood the centrally controlled imperial armies and the regional forces of Hebei Circuit. Once the court learned of the revolt, Emperor Xuanzong appointed his sixth son, Prince Rong Li Wan, as commander-in-chief with the Right Imperial Guard commander Gao Xianzhi as deputy, leading the Kuang cavalry, the Fei cavalry and troops from Shuofang. The Anxi jiedushi Feng Changqing was additionally made jiedushi of Fanyang and Pinglu and marched to the eastern capital, recruiting 60,000 men to hold the Huang River crossing at Heyang; the Eastern Capital garrison commander Li Cheng and the censor-in-chief Lu Yi were assigned to defend Luoyang; in the Guanzhong theatre Geshu Han held a force at Tong Pass, while the relief armies from Longyou, Hexi and Jiannan and the armies of Shuofang jiedushi Guo Ziyi and Hedong jiedushi Li Guangbi advanced by separate routes. Later the war was carried substantially by foreign auxiliaries, above all the Shatuo Uyghurs and the Karluk people. The governors, prefects and magistrates of Hebei Circuit mostly fled or opened their gates to the rebels as the columns passed, so that the administrative and recruitment machinery of the state in Hebei collapsed almost overnight.
people: 安祿山是這場叛亂的策動者。他是粟部突厥人，父粟哥珊為左金吾衛長上，因罪逃出西域，母改嫁安延偃，遂冒姓安；自幼通六蕃語言，兼習歌舞，體肥而動作敏捷，得以在玄宗寵信之下出任平盧、范陽、河東三鎮節度使，掌三鎮兵權、牧場與馬政。直接對手是楊國忠，楊貴妃之兄、右相，屢次向玄宗揭發安祿山謀反，玄宗卻以「祿山無二心，前詔焚之矣」拒納，連密奏都燒了。玄宗李隆基在開元天寶之際怠政，先後以李林甫、楊國忠秉政，造成將相不和。戰場上最先崩潰的是唐廷將領：封常清精於籌略、屢破吐蕃，但所部皆臨時市井募兵，遇戰即潰；高仙芝為高句麗人、哥舒部將，焚太原倉剩餘糧械退守潼關，仍被監軍邊令誠以「失律喪師」進讒，與封常清同被處斬；哥舒翰守潼關本可待敵氣衰，玄宗卻強令其以二十萬弱兵出關，一戰而盡。收復失地者為郭子儀、李光弼、顏杲卿、顏真卿；叛軍內部則是安慶緒、史思明與史朝義父子三代同樣弒父自代的循環。
peopleEn: An Lushan was the man who set the revolt in motion. Born a Turk of the Su tribe, his father Su Geshan served as a senior officer of the Left Imperial Guard and had fled the western regions after an offence; his mother remarried An Yanyan, and the boy therefore took the surname An. He spoke the languages of the six foreign peoples, was trained in song and dance, and was of heavy build but quick in movement, which won him the trust of Xuanzong and the posts of jiedushi over Pinglu, Fanyang and Hedong, with their troops, pastures and horse administration in his hands. His direct opponent was Yang Guozhong, brother of the imperial consort Yang Guifei and right chancellor, who repeatedly reported to Xuanzong that An Lushan was planning treason; the emperor refused to listen, burned even the secret memorial, with the words that Lushan had no second intention. Emperor Xuanzong himself had by the Xuanhe and Tianbao years grown weary of rule and handed government to Li Linfu and then to Yang Guozhong, which produced the fatal friction between minister and general. The first imperial commanders to fail were defeats of their own making: Feng Changqing was an able strategist with a record of defeating the Tibetans, but his troops were hastily recruited townsmen and dissolved at the first real fight; Gao Xianzhi, a Goguryeo-born commander of the Geshu clan, burned the remaining grain and stores at the Taiyuan depot and withdrew to Tong Pass, yet was denounced by the eunuch supervisor Bian Lingcheng as having lost the army in the field, and was beheaded together with Feng Changqing. Geshu Han, who held Tong Pass and wanted to let the rebel army exhaust itself, was ordered by the emperor, on the counsel of Yang Guozhong, to march out with 200,000 raw troops and was destroyed in a single engagement. The men who eventually recovered the lost ground were Guo Ziyi, Li Guangbi, Yan Gaoqing and Yan Zhenqing; on the rebel side the drama was played out by An Qingxu, Shi Siming and the next generation of Shi Chaoyi, who murdered their fathers in turn.
kits: 卡面是一頂科林斯青銅盔，約公元前六五〇年前後出自希臘的科林斯或雅典作坊。盔體完整成形，兩側只留一條橫向的窄眼縫與鼻樑下方的開口，通體飾以獅首、鬃毛與獸面凸起，內襯軟革，頂脊、護頰與盔體連為一體。它是重裝步兵（hoplite）裝束的一環，與方盾（aspis）、胸甲同用，設計前提是頭部與面部防護極高而視野極窄，因此完全靠方陣的密集排列來彌補視線不足；換句話說，戴它的人把生存交給隊形。這頂盔並不出現在755年的范陽，兩者相隔約一千四百年，年代遠在唐代之前。與它在同一環節——頭部防護——上對應的，是唐廷的兜鍪、明光鎧、批鑲甲與護心鏡，以及蕃部騎兵常用的皮甲、小札甲與骨鍪。唐軍甲胄以鐵為主，內襯棉、帛與皮革，外罩紅色或黑色絹紵，兜鍪加垂裙以護頸背。兵器方面，唐軍以長刀、陌刀、方天畫戟、槊、長槍及弓弩為主，攻城用撞車、雲梯與木則；叛軍騎兵以弓與刀為主，步卒持長矛與短刀，並大量取用河北州縣儲存的甲兵與糧秣。馬匹與牧場是安祿山三鎮最重要的戰略物資，軍馬來自柳城、營州、室韋與同羅各部，蕃部騎兵的速度正是這一輪進攻的骨幹。
kitsEn: The card face is a Corinthian helmet, produced in Corinthian or Athenian workshops in Greece around 650 BC. The shell is formed as one piece; each side carries only a narrow horizontal eye slit plus the opening below the nose bridge, and the surface is covered with lion heads, manes and animal-mask reliefs over a soft leather lining, with the crest and cheek guards continuous with the body of the helmet. It is one element of the hoplite panoply, worn together with the aspis shield and cuirass, and its design premise is that head and face protection is extremely high while the field of view is extremely narrow, so that the close order of the phalanx must make up for the loss of sight. In other words, the man wearing it surrendered his survival to the formation. This helmet was not present at Fanyang in 755: the two are separated by roughly fourteen centuries, the helmet belonging to an age long before the Tang. What occupies the same slot in this campaign, namely head protection, is the Tang army's doumao, mingguan armour, plated brigandine and breast mirrors, together with the hide armour, small scale armour and bone caps used by the tribal cavalry. Tang armour was iron-based, lined with cotton, silk and leather, covered in red or black silk gauze, and the doumao carried a hanging skirt to guard the neck and back. In weapon terms the Tang relied on long sabres, the modao, the fangtian huaji, the shuo, long spears, bows and crossbows, and used battering rams, scaling ladders and musou boards for siege work; the rebel cavalry fought with bow and sabre, the foot with long spears and short swords, and drew heavily on the armour and grain stores already held in the Hebei prefectures. Horses and pastures were the most important strategic material of An Lushan's three commands: the mounts came from Liucheng, Yingzhou, the Shewei and the Tongluo, and the speed of the tribal cavalry was the backbone of this offensive.
tactics: 范陽起兵本身是一場以奇襲姿態和政治旗號雙管齊下的行動。安祿山選在承平百餘年、朝廷武備空虛的十一月動手，並以「奉密詔討楊國忠以清君側」自居，把叛軍打扮成替皇帝清除姦臣的義師，用這面旗號去換取關內州縣與河北官軍的猶豫時間。推進方式上，叛軍以同羅、契丹等蕃部騎兵為先鋒，步騎並行，沿河北平原南北縱掃，不戀戰、不攻堅城，只求速取各州州府、縣城、糧倉與馬場；河北道治所與各州多聞風而逃或開城迎降，於是前線實際是靠騎兵速度與行政真空推進，而不是靠攻城器械。唐廷的對應則是節節退守：封常清先在洛陽城北的甕子谷迎戰失利，退守黃河上的河陽橋與洛陽城；叛軍西進，十二月中破洛陽，殺害拒降的東京留守李憕與御史中丞盧奕；封常清與高仙芝力主退守潼關、放棄洛陽，燒毀太原倉中剩餘的糧米財物，甲仗資糧棄於道旁「彌數百里」，全軍退入關中。哥舒翰據潼關不出，以逸待勞，力主待勤王軍會合後再戰；但玄宗與楊國忠強令出關，二十萬新募之兵在靈寶遭叛軍騎兵包抄而全軍覆沒，潼關遂失，關中門戶洞開。叛軍入洛陽後，安祿山稱帝建大燕、改元聖武，以范陽為後方基地，把重心放在鄴城與陳留、睢陽、南陽幾個方向；同羅、契丹兵充當快速縱隊。唐廷此後的戰略轉為固守關中，以郭子儀、李光弼分道收拾河北各鎮，並聯絡回紇迂迴斷其糧道與援路。
tacticsEn: The rising at Fanyang was an operation that combined a surprise in posture with a political banner. An Lushan chose the eleventh month, when the realm had known a century of peace and the court's military readiness was hollow, and he presented himself as acting on a secret imperial edict against Yang Guozhong to clear the ruler's side, dressing the rebel army as an army of righteousness removing a wicked minister, and buying with that banner the hesitation of the prefectures inside the passes and of the Han officers in Hebei. In execution, tribal cavalry from the Tongluo and the Khitan led the way, foot and horse moving together, sweeping north and south along the Hebei plain without lingering and without storming strongholds, caring only to seize quickly the prefectural seats, county towns, granaries and horse pastures. The seat of Hebei Circuit and most of its prefectures fled on the news or opened their gates to the rebels, so that the front was in fact carried by cavalry speed and administrative vacuum rather than by siege engines. The court's answer was a series of withdrawals. Feng Changqing first fought a losing action north of Luoyang at Wengzigou and fell back to the Heyang bridge on the Yellow River and to the city of Luoyang; the rebels drove west, took Luoyang in the middle of the twelfth month and killed the Eastern Capital garrison commander Li Cheng and the censor-in-chief Lu Yi, who refused to surrender. Feng Changqing and Gao Xianzhi argued for abandoning Luoyang and holding Tong Pass, burned the remaining grain and stores in the Taiyuan depot, left their armour and provisions lying along the road for a hundred li, and withdrew into Guanzhong. Geshu Han sat at Tong Pass without engaging, letting the enemy tire and pressing for a set-piece battle only after the relief armies should have joined; the emperor and Yang Guozhong nonetheless forced him out, and 200,000 freshly recruited men were surrounded by rebel cavalry at Lingbao and annihilated, so Tong Pass fell and the gate of Guanzhong stood wide open. After entering Luoyang, An Lushan proclaimed the state of Great Yan and the era of Shengwu, kept Fanyang as his rear base, and threw his weight toward Ye and toward Chenliu, Suiyang and Nanyang, with the Tongluo and Khitan horsemen serving as mobile columns. The court's later strategy was to hold Guanzhong fast, to let Guo Ziyi and Li Guangbi close in on the Hebei commands separately, and to work with the Uyghurs to cut the rebels' supply route and lines of reinforcement by turning movement.
data: 可考的數字集中在兵力與時間兩端。天寶十四載十一月初九，安祿山在薊城南郊誓師，叛軍實集兵約十五萬，對外號稱二十萬；安祿山一人所領平盧、范陽、河東三鎮的帳面兵力為十八萬三千九百人，而天寶中期全國邊鎮總兵力約五十萬，中央直轄軍力不足十三萬，比例上外重內輕。玄宗於同年十一月十五日得報反訊，遣李琬、高仙芝率彍騎、飛騎與朔方兵東征；封常清在洛陽所募兵僅六萬，且多為市井之徒。高仙芝退軍時沿途遺棄的甲仗與資糧「彌數百里」。同年十二月中旬叛軍破洛陽；756年正月一日安祿山在洛陽稱帝，國號大燕、改元聖武，其後再破鄴、廣平、鉅鹿、趙、上谷、博陵、文安、魏、信都九郡，恆山郡太守顏杲卿不降被斬，河北十餘郡相繼歸唐的兵力逾十萬。756年五月，武令珣在南陽擊破魯炅所領荊襄黔中嶺南勤王兵五萬。潼關方面，哥舒翰奉命出關的兵力記為二十萬，靈寶一戰盡沒；同年六月十三日玄宗離長安西幸，皇太子李亨在靈州即位，是為肅宗。757年正月安慶緒弒安祿山自稱；758年郭子儀等九節度使合兵二十餘萬圍鄴城，其後增至六十萬，759年在鄴城被史思明援軍擊敗；761年三月史思明為其子史朝義所殺；763年春天史朝義在林中自縊。叛亂自755年12月至763年2月，前後七年又兩個月。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked cluster on two axes, men and time. On the ninth day of the eleventh month of Tianbao 14, An Lushan mustered his army south of Jicheng in Fanyang: about 150,000 men actually gathered, announced as 200,000. The three commands An Lushan held himself, Pinglu, Fanyang and Hedong, carried an official strength of 183,900, while the border commands of the empire as a whole numbered some 500,000 in the middle of the Tianbao era and the centrally controlled armies fell short of 130,000, a balance of heavy outside and light within. The court learned of the revolt on the fifteenth day of the same eleventh month and sent Li Wan and Gao Xianzhi eastward with the Kuang and Fei cavalry and troops from Shuofang; the force Feng Changqing recruited at Luoyang numbered only 60,000, and most were townsmen. The armour and provisions Gao Xianzhi abandoned on his withdrawal lay along the road for a hundred li. The rebels took Luoyang in the middle of the twelfth month; on the first day of the first month of 756 An Lushan proclaimed himself emperor at Luoyang, founding the state of Great Yan and the era of Shengwu, and afterwards broke the nine prefectures of Ye, Guangping, Julu, Zhao, Shanggu, Boling, Wen'an, Wei and Xindu, while the governor of Hengshan, Yan Gaoqing, refused to surrender and was beheaded; more than 100,000 men in over ten Hebei prefectures then came over to the Tang. In the fifth month of 756 Wu Lingxun defeated at Nanyang the 50,000 relief troops from Jing, Xiang, Qianzhong and Lingnan led by Lu Jiong. At Tong Pass the force Geshu Han was ordered to bring out is recorded as 200,000, annihilated in one day at Lingbao; on the thirteenth of the sixth month of the same year Xuanzong left the capital for the west, and the crown prince Li Heng took the throne at Lingzhou as Suzong. In the first month of 757 An Qingxu killed An Lushan and seized the throne; in 758 the nine jiedushi under Guo Ziyi closed around Ye with more than 200,000, later raised to 600,000, and were defeated there in 759 by a relieving force under Shi Siming. In the third month of 761 Shi Siming was killed by his son Shi Chaoyi; in the spring of 763 Shi Chaoyi hanged himself in the woods. The revolt thus ran from December 755 to February 763, seven years and two months in all.
cause: 起兵的根由，是唐廷在開元、天寶二十餘年間自己製造出來的。制度層面上，府兵制在均田制崩解之後解體，募兵制取而代之，邊軍規模膨脹到五十萬，中央常備軍卻不足十三萬；節度使集軍、政、財於一身，《新唐書》說得太直白：「既有其土地，又有其人民，又有其甲兵，又有其財賦。」河北道的節度使事實上已是半獨立的地方軍閥，朝廷再沒有能夠壓住他的力量。其次是用人結構：為防邊將入相，李林甫主張以胡人出任邊鎮節度使，安祿山等因此長期掌兵；他們在胡風閉塞的環境中成長，漢家禮法對其約束有限，忠於皇帝而疏於朝廷的關係因此格外牢固。第三是將相之隙：楊國忠因安祿山不屬己黨而屢次進讒，玄宗一味姑息，甚至焚其密奏而不究，還公開向安祿山保證「祿山無二心」，等於取消了叛變的時間成本。最後是安祿山自己的算盤：他原本打算等玄宗身後再動手，但楊國忠得寵愈固、必欲先除己，他於是把時點提前到755年冬，趁玄宗怠政、潼關無兵、朝廷久不知兵的空檔舉兵。
causeEn: The roots of the rising were manufactured by the Tang court itself over the more than twenty years of the Xuanhe and Tianbao reigns. On the institutional side, the fubing militia system collapsed as the equal-field system broke down and was replaced by recruitment; the border armies inflated to some 500,000 while the central standing force stayed below 130,000; and the jiedushi held military, administrative and fiscal power in one pair of hands, as the New Book of Tang put it without evasion: they had the land, they had the people, they had the arms and armour, they had the revenue. The jiedushi of Hebei Circuit had become in effect half-independent regional warlords whom the court could no longer overawe. Second was the structure of appointments: to keep frontier commanders out of the chancellorship, Li Linfu argued for using foreigners as jiedushi of the border commands, and men like An Lushan held these posts for long years; they had grown up in a closed frontier environment where Han ritual constrained them little, and their loyalty ran to the emperor personally rather than to the court. Third was the friction between chancellor and general: because An Lushan was not of Yang Guozhong's faction, Yang denounced him again and again, and the emperor simply indulged it, even burning the secret memorial without investigating it and publicly assuring An Lushan that Lushan had no second intention, which in effect removed the cost of rising. Last was An Lushan's own arithmetic: he had meant to wait until Xuanzong's death before acting, but as Yang Guozhong's favour grew he grew certain that Yang would remove him first, so he moved the date forward to the winter of 755 and rose while the emperor was weary of government, while Tong Pass was empty and the court had long forgotten how to fight.
impact: 這場起兵最終拖了七年多，把唐廷從開元天寶的頂點拉回谷底。制度上，中央無力控制河北；戰後唐廷為求速平亂，競相招撫安史舊將，安慶緒、史思明先後被殺，而田承嗣、李懷仙、李寶臣、薛嵩等以原據地與原兵力受封節度使，其中田承嗣在魏博為安祿山、安慶緒、史思明、史朝義立祠，自稱「安史四聖」，河朔三鎮的割據自此延續至唐亡，再通往五代十國的分裂。經濟與戶籍上，北方戰區與兩京殘破，朝廷登記的漢族人口較亂前減少過半，北方農業與漕運體系難以恢復，經濟重心因此加速南移，江南因未受兵禍而承接南遷人口；此後除後唐曾定都洛陽外，多數王朝不再以長安、洛陽為都。民族關係上，唐廷對胡人由開放轉為排拒，李白作《胡無人》詠之，邊防體系與天可汗制度隨之瓦解。對外關係上，平亂借回紇之兵，回紇恃功索取財帛，西域諸地在亂後三十餘年間相繼被吐蕃與回紇佔有，陸上絲路中斷，海上絲路地位上升。一場起兵改寫了此後三百年的政治地理。
impactEn: This rising dragged on for more than seven years and pulled the Tang court from the heights of the Kaiyuan-Tianbao age back into the valley. Institutionally the centre could no longer hold Hebei. To end the war quickly the court competed to pardon and enlist the old An-Shi commanders: An Qingxu and Shi Siming were killed in turn, while Tian Chengsi, Li Huaixian, Li Baochen and Xue Song received the title of jiedushi with the territories and troops they already held. In Weibo, Tian Chengsi raised a shrine to An Lushan, An Qingxu, Shi Siming and Shi Chaoyi and called them the Four Saints of An-Shi. The secession of the three Hebei commands thus ran on until the fall of the Tang and onward into the division of the Five Dynasties and the Ten Kingdoms. Economically and demographically the northern war zone and the two capitals were left in ruins, the Han population registered by the court was reduced by more than half compared with the eve of the disorder, and the northern agricultural and transport systems could not be restored, so the centre of economic gravity moved south with new speed; the Jiangnan, spared the fighting, received the displaced population. Except for the Later Tang, which made Luoyang its capital, later dynasties no longer took Chang'an or Luoyang as their seat. In ethnic terms the court's openness towards the foreign peoples turned to rejection, Li Bai set down his poem on the Hu who are no longer there, and the frontier system and the institution of the Son of Heaven of the Ten Thousand States fell apart. In foreign relations, the war was fought with the help of the Uyghur troops, who extracted payment and silk for their service; the western regions passed successively to the Tibetans and the Uyghurs in the thirty-odd years after the revolt, the overland silk road was cut, and the maritime route rose in its place. A single rising rewrote the political geography of the following three centuries.
result: 就范陽起兵這一刻而言，叛軍勝在河北、在洛陽、在關中的前段：它以數月之速推倒兩京、逼走天子，讓延續一百五十餘年的開元盛世在半年之間崩解。然而它終究只佔有河北與兩京，沒有佔有天下。安祿山在756年正月一日於洛陽稱帝，握著百餘萬人的兵眾卻困守孤城，755年起兵的銳氣在兩京的殘破與河北的拉鋸中耗盡；757年正月，其子安慶緒與近侍合謀弒之而奪位。史思明先降唐，受封歸義王兼范陽節度使，朝廷的懷柔之策反覆，757年後再度反叛，759年解鄴城之圍、殺安慶緒，自立大燕，再演三年同類的父子相殘，761年三月為其子史朝義所殺。763年春天史朝義走投無路，在林中自縊，部將李懷仙以范陽降唐，叛亂自755年12月至763年2月，前後七年又兩個月方告平息。唐廷隨即以招撫換取速平，冊封安史降將為節度使，埋下河朔三鎮與藩鎮割據的種子；這場755年12月16日在范陽點燃的火焰，最後燒掉的是唐朝自己的中央權威。
resultEn: For the moment of the rising at Fanyang itself, the rebels won in Hebei, at Luoyang and in the first stage of the campaign in Guanzhong: in a matter of months they overturned the two capitals and drove the emperor from his throne, so that an age of prosperity that had run for more than a century and a half collapsed in half a year. Yet in the end they held only Hebei and the two capitals, not the empire. An Lushan proclaimed himself emperor at Luoyang on the first day of the first month of 756 and, with armies numbering in the hundreds of thousands, was pinned inside a single city; the momentum of 755 drained away in the ruin of the capitals and the long grinding contest in Hebei. In the first month of 757 his son An Qingxu, with his personal attendants, killed him and seized the throne. Shi Siming first surrendered to the Tang and was granted the title Prince of Guiyi and the post of jiedushi of Fanyang, but the court's policy of conciliation proved fickle and he rebelled again in 757, relieving the siege of Ye in 759, killing An Qingxu and establishing Great Yan once more; three more years of the same filicide followed, until in the third month of 761 his own son Shi Chaoyi killed him. In the spring of 763 Shi Chaoyi, with no road left, hanged himself in the woods and his general Li Huaixian surrendered Fanyang to the Tang. From December 755 to February 763, seven years and two months, the revolt came to an end. The court then bought a quick settlement with pardons, ennobling the surrendered An-Shi commanders as jiedushi and sowing the seeds of the three Hebei commands and of military governorship. The fire lit at Fanyang on 16 December 755 ended by burning the central authority of the Tang itself.
